headline: ماذا حدث حين وحّدت المستشفيات طريقة تسليم المرضى بين المناوبات؟
reviewer: AI editorial review (not a human reader test)

introduction_answers.problem: الأخطاء في تسليم المريض بين المناوبات من الأسباب الرئيسة للأخطاء الطبية.
introduction_answers.who: الأطباء المقيمون في 32 مستشفى أمريكيًا ومرضاهم.
introduction_answers.change: تعلّموا طريقة موحّدة للتسليم (I-PASS) مع تدريب 18 شهرًا، فانخفضت الأحداث الضارة المرتبطة بالتسليم المبلَّغ عنها بنسبة 47%.

summary: وحّدت 32 مستشفى أمريكيًا طريقة تسليم المرضى بين المناوبات مع تدريب ومتابعة، فتحسّنت جودة التسليم وانخفضت الأحداث المبلَّغ عنها، لكن تجربة أسترالية لم تغيّر مؤشرها الرئيس.
terminology_evidence: Handoff, I-PASS (five steps), SBAR (four steps), adverse event, resident physician, pressure injury and the stepped randomized rollout are explained at first use or in the glossary; English terms are in parentheses after the Arabic.
language_evidence: Arabic written natively from meaning; title names the actor (hospitals) and the action; introduction re-read without the title (editorial simulation, not a human reader test).

mobile_evidence.scope: Automated rendered-layout verification; screenshots retained for human visual review

source_evidence.claim: 32 hospitals (12 community, 20 academic); 2,735 residents; 760 faculty champions; 18 months of external coaching with monthly metric reviews
source_evidence.assessment: Prospective pre-post hybrid effectiveness-implementation study; no control group

source_evidence.claim: Handoff-related reported adverse events fell 47%: major 1.7 to 0.9, minor 17.5 to 9.3 per person-year
source_evidence.assessment: Resident-reported surveillance surveys (1,942 reports); denominator is person-years

source_evidence.claim: All five elements: verbal 20% to 66% (n=4,812), written 10% to 74% (n=1,787); receiver synthesis 31% to 83%
source_evidence.assessment: Direct observation with validated tools; percentages of observed handoffs

source_evidence.claim: I-PASS reduces errors and adverse events with moderate certainty (10 studies); SBAR low certainty; other tools insufficient; 12 tools searched
source_evidence.assessment: Making Healthcare Safer IV systematic review, last 10 years

source_evidence.claim: 3 hospitals, 9 wards, 13,753 admissions; primary composite unchanged (OR 0.99); pressure injuries down 41% (absolute 0.8%); safety attitudes 74.6 to 79.7
42 studies, 6 RCTs; adverse events improved in 3/16, errors 3/7, length of stay 3/7, mortality 0/4; combined structural and educational more often positive
source_evidence.assessment: Systematic review of physician inpatient handoff interventions

decision: CI candidate PASS only; authoritative approval is successful GitHub Actions job
